passives.name: Adrenaline Rush

passives.name: Adrenaline Rush
passives.description: Greatly increases Power Raise's charge speed when charged immediately after a combo finisher.

passives.name: Blue Radiance
passives.description: Allows Ares to temporarily join Katalina's attack when Ares gauge is full. Perform a combo finisher, link attack, or skill to summon Ares.

passives.name: Vow by the Sword
passives.description: Katalina's skills and Skybount Art are enhanced while Ares is summoned.

passives.name: Sleight of Hand
passives.description: Bull's Eye Blast charges faster depending no how high the Heat gauge is. Landing primary attacks and link attacks fills the gauge.

passives.name: Rythmic Trigger
passives.description: Allows Rackam to fire 3-shot bursts by long-pressing primary. Burst-fire attacks deal more damage when chained together with perfect timing.

passives.name: Enchanted
passives.description: Stargaze is chargeable up to 4 times based on how many Mystic Vortex orbs Io has. Landing a fully charged primary spell grants an orb.

passives.name: Quick Cast
passives.description: Greatly increases Stargaze's charge speed when charged immediately after gaining a Mystic Vortex orb.

passives.name: Take Aim
passives.description: Eugen can't move while in sniper vision, but he can manually aim his shots to deal more damage.

passives.name: Fists of the Marksman
passives.description: Eugen switches to hand-to-hand combat style against nearby foes.

passives.name: Rose Garden
passives.description: Rosetta plants roses that attack foes within range. Roses level up as the hit foes, enhancing their capabilities.

passives.name: Overgrowth
passives.description: Planted roses grant various buffs to the entire party whenever Rosetta uses a combo finisher. The highest leveled rose determines effect strength.

passives.name: Friends Till the End
passives.description: Landing the final hit of a charged primary attack summons one of Ferry's pets. Performing a link attack summons one of her pets simultaneously.

passives.name: Haunting Army
passives.description: Primary attacks deal more damage based on how many pets are on the battlefield.

passives.name: Stiller Glanz
passives.description: Sustaining rapid primary attacks will eventually coat Lancelot's blades in ice, allowing him to deal more damage.

passives.name: Wirbelwind
passives.description: Dodging an atack via direction+secondary with perfect timing triggers a perfect dodge. Lancelot can then launch into a combo after dodging.

passives.name: Proof of Valor
passives.description: Allows Vane to perform powerful secondary combos by consuming the Beatdown gauge. Landing combo finishers fills the gauge.

passives.name: The Dragon Within
passives.description: Allows Vane to block a foe's attack with a perfectly timed secondary attack without being interrupted.

passives.name: Flamen Rüstung
passives.description: Foe attacks won't interrupt Percival while he's charging Schlacht.

passives.name: Adrenaline Rush
passives.description: Greatly increases Schlacht's charge speed when charged immediately after a combo finisher.

passives.name: Délivrance
passives.description: Enhances perfectly timed primary attacks when they are chained in a combo.

passives.name: DRachenblut
passives.description: Foes attacks won't interrupt Siegfried while he's performing secondary attacks.

passives.name: Noble Stane
passives.description: Performing rapid primary attacks, link attacks, and activating damage skills causes Charlotta's sword to glow, which enhances her attacks.

passives.name: Enforcer of Justice
passives.description: Allows Charlotta to block a foe's attack with a perfectly timed secondary attack without being interrupted.

passives.name: Lost for Words
passives.description: Yodarha's skills are enhanced based on the number of Triple Shroud marks he has. Landing a combo fnisher gives 1 mark.

passives.name: Sharpened Focus
passives.description: Yodarha can chain into another combo by pressing primary after a combo finisher. Each follow-up combo gets chorter, allowing him to trigger finishers more often.

passives.name: Butterfly Effect
passives.description: Narmaya can switch between Dawnfly stance and her Freeflutter stance. Her skills and primary attacks perform differently basd on her stance.

passives.name: Take Flight
passives.description: Narmaya's skills are enhanced based on the number of butterflies she has. Landing specific attacks and link attacks grants butterflies.

passives.name: Eternal Rage Style
passives.description: Ghandagoza's Raging Fist charges faster and deals more damage based on his Eternal Rage. Combo finishers and link attacks gather Eternal Rage.

passives.name: Enter the Fist
passives.description: Enhances perfectly timed primary attacks when they are chained in a combo.

passives.name: Accelerating Flare
passives.description: Allows Zeta to create an airborne attack loop by pressing primary with perfect iming after high jumping. Each successive loop busts her attack.

passives.name: Arvess Resonance
passives.description: Landing a loop finisher after performing 3 loop combos in a row inflicts the Arvess Fermare status ailment.

passives.name: Feel No Pain
passives.description: Vaseraga gains Stout Heart, ATK↑, and DEF↑ based on the level of the Grynoth gauge. Landing charged secondary attacks fills the gauge.

passives.name: Melas Unleashed
passives.description: Pressing secondary attack fills up the Grynoth gauge by a certain amount and grants Stout Heart to Vaseraga.

passives.name: Founder of Alchemy
passives.description: Cagliostro transmutes various implements of murder based on the cmobo she uses.

passives.name: Adrenaline Rush
passives.description: Greatly increases Collapse's charge speed when charged immediately after a combo finisher.

passives.name: Soul Link
passives.description: Allows Id to enter Dragonform upon attacking with secondary once the Versalis gauge is full. Landing specific secondary and link attacks fills the gauge.

passives.name: Godmight
passives.description: Allows Dragonform Id to enter Godmight once 4 outer segments of the Versalis gauge are full. Landing combo finishers and link attacks fills segments.

passives.name: Tetra-Elemental Power
passives.description: Allows Sandalphon to gain Chromatic Wings by charging secondary once the Archangel gauge is full. Landing specific attacks and charging secondary fills the gauge.

passives.name: Righteous Deed
passives.description: Enhances perfectly timed primary attacks when they are chained in a combo.

passives.name: Star Sword Sovereign
passives.description: Allows Seofon to consume the Avatar gauge to summon an avatar with secondary. Landing combo finishers fills the Avatar gauge.

passives.name: Spirit Swords
passives.description: Seofon deals additional attacks based on his Swordshine level. Landing combo finishers while an avatar is summoned raises Swordshine level.

passives.name: Dark Huntress
passives.description: Holding secondary allows Tweyen to lock on to multiple targets based on her Ultrasight level. Landing attacks and skills raises the level.

passives.name: Bring the Thunder
passives.description: Grants Bring the Thunder to Tweyen upon using her SBA. Her damage skills deal more damage and inflict Paralysis while Bring the Thunder is in effect.

passives.name: Stronger of Will, Stronger of Might
passives.description: Allows Gallanza to enter Deathmatch Finale once the Silver Wolf gauge is full. Landing combo finishers and link attacks fills the gauge.

passives.name: Vengeful Turbine
passives.description: After releasing [Unique Attack] of Gallanza's charged [Unique Attack], the final swing deflects a foe's attack to nullify the damage and counter.

passives.name: Étude of Devotion
passives.description: Maglielle•s combo finishers are aimable with [Move Camera]. Landing enough hits with a finisher causes its swords to independently attack foes.

passives.name: Cascading Tremolo
passives.description: Maglielle fires magic swords in front of her with [Unique Attack]. Holding [Unique Attack] prolongs the attack while depleting the Veil gauge. Landing combo finishers fills the gauge.

passives.name: Dual Threat
passives.description: Fraux can flip between Upright stance and Reversed stance. Her [Attack]s and power strikes change based on her stance.

passives.name: Strength Gains
passives.description: Fraux gains 3 free skill activations when both stance gauges are full. These skills are enhanced. Landing attacks and skills fills her gauges.

passives.name: Voidskip
passives.description: Short hold [Unique Attack] to warp to a desired spot. Long hold [Unique Attack] to warp and launch a follow-up attack. Fediel can't be hit by foes while warping.

passives.name: Miasma Hands
passives.description: Allows Fediel to unleash a continuous flurry of claw attacks by repeatedly pressing [Attack] following the attack of a fully charged voidskip.
